test_metrics_protocol.zh: test_metrics 为严格留出测试集口径（n=11230，未参与训练与早停）：rmse/mae 为预测误差，r2/pearson_r 为预测值与 phenoage 的拟合指标。
test_metrics_protocol.en: test_metrics are computed on the strictly held-out test set (n=11230; not used for training or early stopping): rmse/mae are prediction errors; r2/pearson_r reflect agreement between predictions and phenoage.

paper_main_text.zh: 论文主文 r=0.96 / R2=0.92 为全队列拟合口径（训练+测试合并 37433 人实测 r=0.9555 / R2=0.9119）。
paper_main_text.en: The paper's main-text r=0.96 / R2=0.92 uses a whole-cohort fit protocol (train + test pooled, includes in-sample predictions); pooled reproduction on 37,433 participants gives r=0.9555 / R2=0.9119.

paper_supplementary.zh: 论文补充材料 RMSE=3.626 / MAE=2.898 对应 ProtPhenoAge acceleration（ProtPhenoAge ~ PhenoAge 线性回归残差）在留出预测上的 RMS/MAE，非预测误差；本复现实测 RMS=3.6129 / MAE=2.8800，差异属环境/版本级噪声（见 environment_variation）。
paper_supplementary.en: The paper's supplementary RMSE=3.626 / MAE=2.898 correspond to the RMS/MAE of ProtPhenoAge acceleration (residuals of a linear regression of ProtPhenoAge on PhenoAge) on held-out predictions, not prediction errors; this reproduction gives RMS=3.6129 / MAE=2.8800. The gap is environment/version-level noise (see environment_variation).

environment_variation.zh: 不同运行环境（XGBoost 版本、操作系统/硬件平台、线程数等）会造成重训与预测的细微数值差异（浮点累加顺序、直方图分箱边界不同）。本复现模型与论文模型的预测值相关系数为 0.999，上述 0.4%–0.6% 的指标差异属于环境级噪声，不代表模型本质不同。
environment_variation.en: Different runtime environments (XGBoost version, OS/hardware platform, thread count, etc.) produce slight numerical differences in retraining and prediction (floating-point accumulation order and histogram bin boundaries differ). The predictions of this reproduction correlate with the paper's model at r=0.999; the 0.4%–0.6% metric gaps above are environment-level noise, not a materially different model.
